messages:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — running into a recurring confusion on AcmeCorp accounts where both an SI and field rep claim a co-sell. Need a short, repeatable rule. Thoughts?
Raj Chen: Is this the marketplace-influenced ones or direct-sales sourced?
Priya Patel: Mostly marketplace leads that SIs later pick up for implementation. Sometimes field claims because ARR looks larger.
Maya Li: Quick proposal: marketplace-origin leads default to SI first-touch for 30 days unless ARR > $750k then field auto-assigns. Exceptions flagged with `co-sell-exempt`.
Jules Ortega: How do we handle account mapping when SFDC shows two parent accounts (partner and customer)? Last time it created duplicate claims.
IntegrationsBot: FYI — created mapping ticket #INT-482 in Intake board for AcmeCorp duplicate-parent mapping.
Raj Chen: I like Maya's rule but want a carve for named accounts: if field has existing active opportunity in last 12 months, field retains priority even if ARR < $750k.
Maya Li: Agreed. So combined rule: marketplace->SI default 30d, ARR>750k -> field, field active opp (12mo) -> field. Tag exceptions `co-sell-exempt`.
Sofia Gonzales: From a legal/SLA side we should require a short partner MOU in SFDC before any SI claims for deals > $250k — reduces finger-pointing later.
Priya Patel: Good call. I'll add a step: SI claim auto-creates MOU task for deals >250k and blocks outreach until MOU checkbox checked.
Jules Ortega: For implementation: here's a quick mapping snippet we can give eng to enforce in the queue logic:
```
if lead.origin == 'marketplace':
  if lead.arr > 750000: assign('field')
  elif field.active_opp_in_12mo(lead.account): assign('field')
  else: assign('si', grace_period_days=30)
```
Priya Patel: Perfect. Can someone spin up a 30-min sync tomorrow to lock wording and add to the partner playbook?
Raj Chen: I can do 10:30am PT. Will send calendar invite.
Maya Li: I'll draft the playbook blurb and include the mapping example + MOU step.
IntegrationsBot: Automated note — will watch for SFDC mapping changes and post back to this thread.
Priya Patel: Thanks all — action items: Raj sends invite, Maya drafts playbook, Jules/Eng picks up INT-482. We'll reconvene after the doc is in. :thumbsup:
